objective: Study a separate HEX8 selective reduced integration research variant without changing standard HEX8.

formulation.kernel: Cdev full integration plus Cvol centre integration

baseline_cases.geometry: cantilever L=20, W=1, H=1; structured HEX8 nx=4,8,16 and ny=nz=2
baseline_cases.load: unit vertical nodal resultant distributed over the free end

predeclared_gates.rank: exactly six numerical rigid-body null modes within 1e-10 of max eigenvalue and no additional null mode above that threshold
predeclared_gates.locking_reduction: fine-level (nx=16) relative displacement error reduction >= 0.50 for nu=0.4999, with no SRI instability gate failure
predeclared_gates.mesh_convergence: SRI and standard records are finite at all three levels; SRI fine error does not increase versus the preceding level

excluded: modal, Newmark, harmonic, buckling and mixed-large workflows
